verdict.rationale: LobeHub's developer docs link an OpenAPI specification for HTTP integration and say the official SDK is generated from OpenAPI. A live probe confirmed a downloadable https://lobehub.com/openapi.json containing an "openapi" key. Missing for 10: documentation of the spec's coverage and versioning across self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://lobehub.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
